name: Regimo Diraja
bio: Under the new authority, petitioners from several communities can seek Regimo’s hearing. His later portfolio does not tell a trader who received them before the fall.
notes: fact: Pires calls Regimo Tumunguo and describes his post-conquest responsibility for Luzon traders, Parsees and Malays (Pires II, p. 281)
inference: Birch’s Caciz and Regunecerage cannot be silently equated with Regimo, and his earlier office is unknown (Birch III, pp. 166–167; people-factions.md §2)
gameplay: His place in the expedition’s aftermath contacts signifies a petition route under the new regime, not expedition membership or a sultanate appointment (people-factions.md §§2, 4)
